calls.title: 1-hr 1:1 with Kelly Wortham
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies for relaunching the event under the new name 'Optimizers Conference' and relocating to Santa Cruz to attract 130 attendees. Key additions include sponsorship packages at a flat fee of $12,500 and an early bird ticket price of $15.95. Enhancements also include experience add-ons for sponsors and potential shuttle services. Content access will involve separate charges for recordings, with a new website set to launch in September-October. Marketing strategies face challenges on LinkedIn due to organic reach limitations. The emphasis on speaker diversity seeks to include more women, while partnerships are expanding through collaborations like the one with Analytics Ninja at Steve Madden.
calls.keywords: Optimizers Conference, Sponsorship Packages, Speaker Recommendations, Event Marketing, Growthbook Partnership, Chicago Happy Hour
